    FROM flights

          AND source_skill = 'tau2Airline'

    print(f"  {r[0]} | {r[2]}->{r[3]} | dep={r[4]} arr={r[5]} | stops={r[7]} | status={r[8]}")
    dates = json.loads(r[10]) if r[10] else {}
    prices = json.loads(r[9]) if r[9] else {}

    print(f"    prices: {prices}")

print("\\n--- All direct flights from LOS ---")
cur.execute("SELECT flight_id, origin, destination, dates_json FROM flights WHERE origin='LOS' AND stops=0")
for r in cur.fetchall():
    dates = json.loads(r[3]) if r[3] else {}

cur.execute("SELECT DISTINCT destination FROM flights")

conn.close()
